description:
Intetics is looking for a Senior Java Developer with strong experience in Java, RESTful web services, Angular, and SQL.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain Java applications and RESTful web services.
  • Build and enhance frontend functionality using Angular.
  • Work with SQL databases and optimize queries.
  • Collaborate with the project team to clarify requirements and deliver solutions.
  • Participate in code reviews, troubleshooting, and technical discussions.

  • 8–10 years of professional experience in Java development.
  • Strong experience developing and integrating RESTful web services.
  • Hands-on experience with Angular.
  • Solid knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with a distributed team.

Nice to have

  • Experience with FreeMarker.
  • Experience with Smooks.

Location and working arrangements

  • Hybrid — Dallas, Texas: ability to work from the Dallas office a few times per week.
